Source voxel arrays, source roles and affine geometry are preserved; no tissue is pre-removed.

motion_proxy_definition: A zero-target movement attempt requests an axis move but has zero tumor-removal reward. Requested mm = count x 2. This includes rejections, partial commands, reversals and healthy-only movement; actual wasted travel is not measured.
